questions.q: The angle of elevation is measured from the ____.
options: line of sight down to the horizontal
horizontal up to the line of sight
questions.explanation: It is the angle you look up above the horizontal.

questions.q: A 10 m ladder makes an angle of 30° with the ground. How high does it reach on the wall?

The angle of depression from the top of a building to a point on the ground equals the angle of elevation from that point to the top because ____.
questions.explanation: Parallel horizontal lines create equal alternate angles.
